power.method: Solar (45W panel), swappable internal battery, AC/DC (12VDC direct / 120V AC adapter), pole tap

features: License Plate Recognition (LPR) on vehicles up to 100 mph (161 km/h) across the entire field of view
Captures license plates in total darkness with 850 nm pulsed LED illumination
Captures vehicle make, model and color
Capture range 30-75 ft (9.1-22.9 m), multi-lane coverage (24 ft / 7.3 m field of view)
Quick self-install and configuration via Mobile Companion app (Android/iOS)
Solar, battery, AC/DC and pole-tap power options with swappable internal battery
Bluetooth 5 LE, WiFi 802.11ac and internal LTE cellular modem
Pairs with VehicleManager Enterprise for hot lists, alerts and patented analytics
